item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Validation API for the data-validation work sample.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport math\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Validate and normalize every row using the supplied policy.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    accepted = []\\n    errors = []\\n    seen = set()\\n\\n    for index, row in enumerate(request[\\\"rows\\\"]):\\n        identifier = row.get(\\\"id\\\")\\n        amount = row.get(\\\"amount\\\")\\n        unit = row.get(\\\"unit\\\", policy[\\\"base_unit\\\"])\\n\\n        if not isinstance(identifier, str) or not identifier:\\n            cause = \\\"id\\\"\\n        elif (\\n            isinstance(amount, bool)\\n            or not isinstance(amount, (int, float))\\n            or not math.isfinite(amount)\\n            or amount < 0\\n        ):\\n            cause = \\\"amount\\\"\\n        elif unit not in policy[\\\"units\\\"]:\\n            cause = \\\"unit\\\"\\n        elif policy[\\\"unique\\\"] and identifier in seen:\\n            cause = \\\"duplicate\\\"\\n        else:\\n            cause = None\\n\\n        if cause is not None:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": cause})\\n            continue\\n\\n        accepted.append({\\n            \\\"id\\\": identifier,\\n            \\\"amount\\\": amount * policy[\\\"units\\\"][unit],\\n        })\\n        seen.add(identifier)\\n\\n    if errors:\\n        return {\\\"ok\\\": False, \\\"records\\\": [], \\\"errors\\\": errors}\\n    return {\\\"ok\\\": True, \\\"records\\\": accepted, \\\"errors\\\": []}\\n\"}},{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\",\"content\":\"[\\n  {\\n    \\\"ok\\\": true,\\n    \\\"records\\\": [\\n      {\\n        \\\"id\\\": \\\"sample_0\\\",\\n        \\\"amount\\\": 4\\n      }\\n    ],\\n    \\\"errors\\\": []\\n  }\\n]\\n\"}}]}"}
